entities.summary: Donald Barry Clarke was a New Zealand rugby union player who played 89 times as a New Zealand international from 1956 until 1964. He was best known for his phenomenal goal kicking ability that earned him the nickname "The Boot". He also played first-class cricket between 1950–51 and 1962–63. Later he lived in South Africa.
